test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf GPT-J 99 Server compliant validation
test_case.purpose: Run the release-supported GPT-J 99 Server benchmark and compare a valid result with a matched MLCommons v4.0 reference.
required_package: Licensed v4.0 harness/LoadGen/container and GPT-J99 model/data/config
Release-correct balanced Server command and load/latency/accuracy settings
Comparable reference and approved score delta
test_case.test_command: Validate hashes/licenses, assets and GPU health; resolve the supported balanced equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=gptj --scenarios=server"`; run required accuracy and Server performance/validity stages; preserve full LoadGen/detail/summary, accuracy, throughput/P99 and telemetry; restore settings and compare only to the bound GPT-J99 Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: GPT-J99 Server accuracy and LoadGen validity pass; throughput/latency meets the approved comparable delta and the platform remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact GPT-J99 Server identity, runnable release command, compliant accuracy/validity and approved threshold. BERT/Offline output, syntax failure or missing delta cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dry-validate the balanced release command before long run.
Abort on validity or health limits.
Do not claim official submission status; preserve all logs.
expected_evidence: Artifact hashes/licenses and exact resolved command
test_case.recovery: Stop invalid/unhealthy runs, preserve evidence, remove only test-created state, restore runtime/power settings and verify GPUs before any new approval.
